title: v1.2 A-I3 PromptSpec metadata (prompt.yaml)
description: Versioned prompt metadata. content_hash is the pinned, authoritative hash of the semantic prompt material (prompt_id + version + exact system.txt / user.txt text + required_variables). The registry recomputes it and fails closed on any mismatch, so a same-version mutation is never silently accepted. content_hash itself never participates in its own computation.
